canDoYue: 你識接電話、留口訊、轉駁，仲識核對串法。
canDoEn: Answer a call, take a message, transfer, and check a spelling.

dialogue.speaker: nia
dialogue.text: Good morning, is Nia calling from harbor office, and how may I help?
dialogue.glossYue: 早晨，我係海港辦事處嘅 Nia 打嚟，有咩可以幫你？
dialogue.say: Good morning, is Nia calling from harbor office, and how may I help?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I speak to Mei regarding appointment, and may I ask if she is available?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以同 Mei 講關於個預約，順便問吓佢有冇空？
dialogue.say: I speak to Mei regarding appointment, and may I ask if she is available?

dialogue.speaker: nia
dialogue.text: She is not available right now, so hold and I will try other line.
dialogue.glossYue: 佢而家冇空，唔該等陣，我試吓另一條線。
dialogue.say: She is not available right now, so hold and I will try other line.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: take message, and ask her to return my call when it is convenient.
dialogue.glossYue: 唔該幫我留個言，方便嘅時候叫佢覆我電話。
dialogue.say: take message, and ask her to return my call when it is convenient.

dialogue.speaker: nia
dialogue.text: I will transfer you if line is free, or I can note callback number.
dialogue.glossYue: 如果線路得閒我會轉駁，或者我記低覆電號碼。
dialogue.say: I will transfer you if line is free, or I can note callback number.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could you say spelling slowly, and read extension back to me?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以慢慢講個串法，再將內線讀返畀我？
dialogue.say: Could you say spelling slowly, and read extension back to me?

dialogue.speaker: nia
dialogue.text: spelling is M E I clearly.
dialogue.glossYue: 字母係 M E I，清楚啲，分機係四二。
dialogue.say: spelling is M E I clearly.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Thank you for message, and callback afternoon would be convenient.
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝你幫我留言，今日下晝覆電會方便。
dialogue.say: Thank you for message, and callback afternoon would be convenient.

understand.prompt: Could I speak to Mei? 即係問緊咩？
May I ask who is calling? 即係問緊咩？
understand.explain: who is calling 係問邊位。

chunks.pattern: Could I ___ to Mei regarding the appointment this afternoon?
chunks.example: Could I speak to Mei regarding the appointment this afternoon?
chunks.glossYue: 今日下晝可唔可以⋯⋯ Mei，關於個預約？

chunks.pattern: Please ___ while I try the other line for a minute.
chunks.example: Please hold while I try the other line for a minute.
chunks.glossYue: 我試另一條線，唔該⋯⋯一陣。

chunks.pattern: I will ___ you if the line is free later this afternoon.
chunks.example: I will transfer you if the line is free later this afternoon.
chunks.glossYue: 如果線路得閒，我遲啲會⋯⋯你。

chunks.pattern: Could you say the ___ slowly, and read the extension back to me?
chunks.example: Could you say spelling slowly, and read extension back to me?
chunks.glossYue: 可唔可以慢慢講個⋯⋯，再將內線讀返？

quiz.prompt: 聽一次，揀你聽到嘅字：你等緊嗰條線
聽一次，揀你聽到嘅字：人唔喺度時留低嘅口訊

客人講「I will transfer you if line is free, or I can note callback number.」，係咩意思？

quiz.explain: line 開頭係 /l/。hold 同 message 冇。

sound.title: 線路開頭嗰個音
sound.note: line 開頭係 /l/。舌尖抵住上顎後面。hold 開頭係 /h/。message 開頭係 /m/。
